import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleIntersection
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietorisConsumer

/-!
# The antipodal cover of a product with the circle

Each chart of the product cover retracts onto the first factor. The intersection
is homotopy equivalent to the product with the real unit sphere, which consists
of two points. The chart equivalences retain the projection maps needed to
compute the Mayer--Vietoris sequence for Mumford's integral cohomology theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The inverse image of a subspace under the second projection is a product. -/
def prodSndPreimageHomeomorph (X Y : TopCat) (U : Set Y) :
    (Prod.snd ⁻¹' U : Set (X × Y)) ≃ₜ X × U where
  toFun p := (p.1.1, ⟨p.1.2, p.2⟩)
  invFun p := ⟨(p.1, p.2.1), p.2.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val).prodMk
    ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)
  continuous_invFun := (continuous_fst.prodMk
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).subtype_mk _

/-- Projection away from a contractible factor is a homotopy equivalence. -/
def prodContractibleHomotopyEquiv (X Y : TopCat) [ContractibleSpace Y] :
    ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv (X × Y) X :=
  ((ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv.refl X).prodCongr
    (ContractibleSpace.hequiv_unit Y).some).trans
      (Homeomorph.prodUnique X Unit).toHomotopyEquiv

@[simp]
theorem prodContractibleHomotopyEquiv_apply (X Y : TopCat) [ContractibleSpace Y]
    (p : X × Y) : prodContractibleHomotopyEquiv X Y p = p.1 := rfl

/-- A punctured-circle chart in a product. -/
def circleProductChart (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) : Set (X × Circle) :=
  Prod.snd ⁻¹' {v}ᶜ

/-- The antipodal product charts form an open cover. -/
theorem circleProductChart_open_cover (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    IsOpen (circleProductChart X v) ∧ IsOpen (circleProductChart X (-v)) ∧
      circleProductChart X v ∪ circleProductChart X (-v) = Set.univ := by
  refine ⟨isOpen_compl_singleton.preimage continuous_snd,
    isOpen_compl_singleton.preimage continuous_snd, ?_⟩
  ext p
  simp only [circleProductChart, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_preimage,
    Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  by_cases h : p.2 = v
  · right
    rw [h]
    exact (Circle.neg_ne_self v).symm
  · exact Or.inl h

/-- The ordinary singular Mayer--Vietoris sequence for the antipodal product
cover. -/
theorem circleProductMayerVietoris_exact (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
      (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n).Exact := by
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hcover⟩ := circleProductChart_open_cover X v
  exact singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_consumer
    (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    hU hV hcover n

/-- Projection identifies a product chart up to homotopy with the first factor. -/
def circleProductChartHomotopyEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv (circleProductChart X v) X := by
  letI := puncturedCircle_contractible v
  exact (prodSndPreimageHomeomorph X (TopCat.of Circle) {v}ᶜ).toHomotopyEquiv.trans
    (prodContractibleHomotopyEquiv X (TopCat.of ({v}ᶜ : Set Circle)))

@[simp]
theorem circleProductChartHomotopyEquiv_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (p : circleProductChart X v) : circleProductChartHomotopyEquiv X v p = p.1.1 := rfl

/-- Pullback by the first projection computes the cohomology of either chart. -/
def circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology X n ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (circleProductChart X v)) n :=
  singularCohomologyHomotopyEquiv (circleProductChartHomotopyEquiv X v) n

@[simp]
theorem circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductChartCohomologyEquiv X v n c =
      singularCohomologyPullback
        (TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun p : circleProductChart X v => p.1.1,
          continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩) n c := rfl

/-- The overlap retracts onto two copies of the first factor, indexed by the
real unit sphere. -/
def circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv
      (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) : Set (X × Circle))
      (X × Metric.sphere (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
  (prodSndPreimageHomeomorph X (TopCat.of Circle)
    ({v}ᶜ ∩ {-v}ᶜ)).toHomotopyEquiv.trans
      ((ContinuousMap.HomotopyEquiv.refl X).prodCongr
        ((circleChartIntersectionHomeomorphPuncturedReal v).toHomotopyEquiv.trans
          puncturedNormedSpaceHomotopyEquivSphere))

@[simp]
theorem circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv_fst (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (p : (circleProductChart X v ∩ circleProductChart X (-v) : Set (X × Circle))) :
    (circleProductIntersectionHomotopyEquiv X v p).1 = p.1.1 := rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
